question: Which of the following folds are extreme types of overturned folds in which the axial plane acquires an almost horizontal attitude?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Recumbent folds.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Folds are the **outcome of the bending of the Earth’s crust** by **compression force.**
 
• A **recumbent fold** is literally a fold lying down, resulting from the **continuation of pressure**.
 
• In the **Recumbent fold**, **Two limbs are Parallel as well as Horizontal to each other**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 **Types of Folds**
 **Explanation**
 
 

 **Symmetrical folds**
 The limbs of the **folds are equally inclined** on either side. Their axial plane is** vertical.**
 
 

 **Asymmetrical folds**
 The limbs of the folds are** not equally **inclined. Their axial plane is** Inclined**
 
 

 **Anticline Fold **
 An anticline is a fold that is** convex

 upwards.**
 
 

 **Syncline Fold**
 A syncline is a fold that is** concave

 upwards. **
 
 

 **Overturned Fold**
 If in any fold both limbs dip towards the** same direction.**
